shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; git diff --stat 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo '---'; ls node_modules/next/dist/experimental 2>/dev/null | head -40

cd /workspace && grep -rn "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/build/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo '=== cacheLife/cacheTag exports ==='; grep -rn "cacheLife\|cacheTag\|use cache\|cacheComponents" node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40

cd /workspace && grep -rn "cacheLife\|cacheTag\|cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo '=== cacheLife in cache.d.ts ==='; find node_modules/next/dist -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "export declare function cacheLife\|export function cacheLife\|cacheLife:" 2>/dev/null | head; echo '=== use cache types ==='; find node_modules/next/types -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "use cache\|cacheLife\|cacheTag" 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace && grep -rn "cacheLife\|cacheTag" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/@next/cached-module-types/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/route-modules/app-page/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo '=== broad search ==='; grep -rln "cacheLife" node_modules/next/dist 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace && grep -rn "cacheLife\|cacheTag" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo '=== next/cache entry ==='; cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60
cd /workspace && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -iname "*cache*" -o -iname "*partial*" 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace && grep -rn "export.*connection\|connection(" node_modules/next/dist/server/request/connection.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/api-utils/node/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo '=== connection export ==='; grep -rn "connection" node_modules/next/dist/server/request/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/next/dist -name "connection.d.ts" 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace && grep -rn "connection" node_modules/next/server.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo '=== next/server entry ==='; grep -n "connection\|cookies\|headers" node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /workspace && find app -type f | sort; echo '---tsconfig---'; cat tsconfig.json

cd /workspace && curl -s -i -H 'Cookie: member=Aisha; team=Platform' -H 'x-region:eu-west' http://localhost:3217/ 2>&1 | head -40; echo '=== BODY ==='; curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Aisha; team=Platform' -H 'x-region:eu-west' http://localhost:3217/ 2>&1

cd /workspace && echo '=== Request 2: different member/team/region ==='; curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Diego; team=Design' -H 'x-region:us-east' http://localhost:3217/ 2>&1 | grep -oE '(Welcome, [^<]*|Team: [^<]*|Region: [^<]*|Loading member details|Workspace|active projects)' | head; echo '=== Request 3: defaults (no cookies/headers) ==='; curl -s http://localhost:3217/ 2>&1 | grep -oE '(Welcome, [^<]*|Team: [^<]*|Region: [^<]*|Loading member details|Workspace|active projects)' | head
